sections.h2: Windsor Oaks West Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 154 residential sales closed in Windsor Oaks West (Virginia Beach, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $377,450, close to the citywide median of $405,000, and homes took a median of 11 days to sell, about the same pace as the citywide median of 15 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Windsor Oaks West sales closed between $314,999 and $415,000, or about $225 per square foot against $240 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($400,000, 70 sales) was about 8% higher than in the earlier 12 months ($369,450, 84 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Windsor Oaks West
sections.html:
71% of the sales were detached homes and 29% were attached homes (townhomes or condos). The median home was about 1,656 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,496 to 1,798 square feet. 49% of the homes that sold had 3 bedrooms.

Most homes that sold were built between 1967 and 1979, with a median year built of 1972, so this is mostly homes from the 1970s through the 1990s.

Averages hide a lot, so Chris Jenkins compares you to homes that match yours on street, size, age and condition rather than to the whole Windsor Oaks West median.
